scope: Diagnostic only: conservation, competition, role labels, missing helper/space paths. No new mechanism, card, coefficient, season simulation or downloads. Finish this item and stop.
label: Four seasons already seen; synthetic probes reveal model behavior, not real causal effects or accuracy gains.

kernel.input: Frozen pure v3 FG rebound kernel, five stint signals off/no map. No team/FT/period-expiry branch in kernel probe; actual game audit checks these separately.
kernel.neutral: PG,SG,SF,PF,C, all rebound=physique=70. Synthetic modifications use rebound99, physique unchanged, unless anchor explicitly physique90.
kernel.exposure: Equal weights over short/mid/long misses and five shooter indices, independent of cards. Designed exposure, not estimated NBA frequencies.
kernel.talentStack: k=0..5 strong rebounders. Average exact probabilities across every subset of k slots to avoid choosing favorable positions. 30% uniform luck and existing 5%-60% team probability clamp preserved.
kernel.realTop5: Per season deduplicate by playerId using card with largest observed in-team MIN, sum observed MIN across teams for >=1000MIN eligibility. Select top5 official OREB_PCT, tie lower playerId. Use unchanged v3 attributes and nominal court positions, not OREB_PCT as a new probability input.
kernel.role: Neutral teammates, anchor index4 rebound99/physique90. Baseline C; change pos only with courtPosition=C; change courtPosition only to PG; swap PG/C courtPosition to retain balanced labels. Actual attributes/physical traits unchanged. Report per-zone nonshooter and anchor-shooter effects plus exposure-average team/player probability. Defensive-side effects separately.
kernel.ignoredInputs: Add boxOut=99,boxOutHelp=99 to anchor; independently add reboundStartDistanceFeet=0 vs30 to all players, crashIntent=0 vs1. Compare full output probabilities exactly; these are hypothetical metadata probes, not new observed skills.
kernel.sampling: Each seed draws 10000 zone/shooter/side/recipient uniforms, shared across scenarios. One Bernoulli team decision then one categorical recipient. Save seed means and SE; exact probabilities are primary.

actualGameAudit.games: 20 seeds per case, 140 games. Five-player synthetic teams against neutral; full frozen 2025-26 v3 timing/accounting constants, five signals off, defenseSignals deleted, no substitutions/fatigue/rotation/minute targets; foulOut99. This controls exposure, not realistic rotations.
actualGameAudit.ledger: For each completed opportunity: sum player OREB+DREB+teamOreb+teamDreb across sides equals reboundChances. Replay must have one terminal rebound per preceding FGX/final nontechnical FTX; nonfinal FT dead rebounds separate; expiry can leave a miss unresolved. More than one OREB in poss allowed only following another miss.
actualGameAudit.parity: boxOutHigh and distanceFar must match neutral exactly in scores, full team/player stats and events if inputs are unused; anchorPosOnlyPG kernel parity required, full-game differences if other paths consume pos must be reported without attributing them to rebounding.
actualGameAudit.accuracy: No win/net MAE or adoption claim from synthetic games; no new constants calibrated.

hustle.input: Existing league-wide Totals hustle tables only, no new acquisition.
hustle.summary: BOX_OUT_PLAYER_TEAM_REBS minus BOX_OUT_PLAYER_REBS; OFF_BOXOUTS and DEF_BOXOUTS separately. Raw player-credited records, not unique team possessions. No offensive/defensive recovery split invented; do not infer causal extra boards or convert into additive board counts.
hustle.validity: Report invalid negative differences or team recovery>boxouts; never silently force counts to fit.

rules.missingMechanism: Zero exact response to a hypothetical field documents absence, not evidence that real boxing-out or distance has no effect.
rules.uncertainty: Kernel seed SE/t19 interval measures Monte Carlo error only, not franchise generalization or real causal effect. No franchise+seed adoption comparison in this item.
rules.proposal: Write a chronological next-mechanism specification, measurable labels, unidentifiable effects, no fabricated fitted constants. Do not implement it in this diagnostic.
